# Feature: docs-and-user-guide

> **Status**: `complete`
>
> **Partially superseded by `19-everything-in-session`** (2026-07):
> AC-5's CI setup steps (judgment-gate secret, conversation-resolution
> branch protection) were replaced by local-tool prerequisites; its
> Verify command no longer passes by design.

This file is the primary execution and maintenance contract for the
enforcement-layer documentation sweep.

## What

Bring the user-facing docs in line with the enforcement layer: README
(artifact model, how-it-works, installed footprint, a new Enforcement
section), the docs site (`docs/index.html`, `docs/quickstart.html`),
and final write-back of the remaining TODO anchors in the
rule-enforcement wiki entry.

## Acceptance Criteria

Each criterion must reference a verification command that fails before
the change (Red) and passes after (Green). Run each `Verify` command
from the repo root.

- [x] AC-1: README describes the enforcement layer — rules are
      compiled into linter config, checks, scoped instructions, and
      gates, not merely read.
      Verify: `grep -Fi 'enforcement' README.md && grep -Fi 'compiled' README.md`
- [x] AC-2: The README artifact model table lists the checks directory
      and templates.
      Verify: `grep -F '.github/idd/checks/' README.md`
- [x] AC-3: The README installed-footprint tree includes the new
      artifacts.
      Verify: `awk '/## Installed Footprint/,/## License/' README.md | grep -F 'checks'`
- [x] AC-4: The docs site covers the enforcement layer on both pages.
      Verify: `grep -Fi 'enforcement' docs/index.html && grep -Fi 'enforcement' docs/quickstart.html`
- [x] AC-5: The quickstart documents the two setup steps consuming
      repos must take manually: the CI secret for the judgment gate
      and the "require conversation resolution" branch-protection
      setting.
      Verify: `grep -Fi 'conversation resolution' docs/quickstart.html`
- [x] AC-6: No TODO anchors remain in the rule-enforcement wiki entry
      — the compiler-entrypoint anchor now points at the real §7
      procedure and templates.
      Verify: `! grep -F 'TODO: anchor' .github/idd/wiki/rule-enforcement.md`

## TDD

Execute each acceptance criterion as a Red → Green → Anchor loop, per
`wiki::red-green-tdd::mental-model`. All `Verify` commands above fail
at spec-authoring time (Red confirmed). `grep`/`awk` verifications are
valid for docs changes.

## Details

### Constraints

- Docs must present enforcement with the wiki entry's framing: the
  capability-invariance rationale (retrieval of team choice does not
  improve with models) is user-facing messaging, not internal history
  (`wiki::rule-enforcement::decisions`).
- README stays the concise front door; depth lives in the wiki entry
  and the docs site. Do not duplicate the full mental model into
  README.
- CHANGELOG is generated by semantic-release; do not hand-edit it.

### Out of Scope

- Any behavior change; this feature is documentation only.
- Restructuring the docs site beyond the new content.
